research.facts:
HARPPA Nordi Toddler Tower Stool Recall
**Sources:**
- cpsc.gov: "HARPPA Recalls Nordi Toddler Tower Stools Due to Risk of Serious Injury and Death from Entrapment and Fall Hazards"
- karmactive.com: "CPSC Recalls HARPPA Nordi Toddler Tower Stools Over Entrapment and Fall Hazards"
- medicaldaily.com: "Federal Regulators Recall 138,000 Toddler Kitchen Towers Because a Child's Torso Can Fit Through the Side Openings"
- harppababy.com: "2026 Harppa Nordi Foldable Toddler Tower Model HANS0002 Voluntary Recall"
**Key Facts:**
- Product: HARPPA Nordi Foldable Toddler Tower Stool — model HANS0002 [HIGH — CPSC official]
- Units recalled: 47,166 [HIGH — CPSC]
- Hazard: Stool can collapse/tip over; child's torso can fit through front/back openings (entrapment, fall, strangulation) [HIGH — CPSC]
- Incidents: 3 reports of collapse/tipping; 2 injuries (scrapes, cuts, bruises) [HIGH — CPSC]
- Sold: harppababy.com and Amazon, September 2023 – June 2026 [HIGH]
- Price: ~$130 [HIGH]
- Description: White, black, blue with natural wood step/platform; 18"D x 18"W x 38.6"H [HIGH]
- Model: HANS0002 on label underside of platform [HIGH]
- Remedy: Free repair kit (protective nets, stabilizing feet + installation instructions, with shipping) from HARPPA [HIGH]
- Note: Medical Daily headline says "138,000" — this may be a different source or an error. CPSC official page says 47,166. Use CPSC figure. [MEDIUM on discrepancy — use 47,166]

research.facts:
September Peak Asthma Season
**Sources:**
- American Lung Association (national guidance)
- AAP (asthma action plans)
- El Paso County Public Health: 719-578-3199 [from prior COS research]
**Key Facts:**
- Timing: "Asthma Spike Day" — typically the third Monday of September (Sept 15, 2026) — also called the "Asthma Tuesday" — when ER visits for children peak [MEDIUM — well-documented but specific date varies by year]
- Colorado Springs elevation: 6,035 feet [HIGH]
- September triggers: ragweed pollen peaks, mold from leaf litter, back-to-school viral spread, end-of-summer wildfire smoke [HIGH — general medical consensus]
- Drier air at altitude = additional airway drying [MEDIUM]
- AAP guidance: every child with asthma should have a written asthma action plan on file at school with nurse [HIGH — AAP]
- Rescue inhalers: should be in child's backpack AND a backup at school office [HIGH — standard guidance]
- El Paso County Public Health: 719-578-3199 [MEDIUM — use as contact]
- Colorado Wildfire smoke: historically common in September [HIGH — general]
